description: The FAIRiCUBE project publishes a 100-metre raster of Vienna administrative districts. Its own page lists codes zero through 23, with zero blank and the other codes mapped to the named city districts. Zenodo lists one small public GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. The layer could assign simulated infrastructure service, outage or heat-exposure outcomes to district reporting units. It is a boundary lookup, not a population or asset inventory, and cell boundaries will not exactly represent the legal district polygons at finer scales. The page does not state a boundary reference year or the source authority for the district map. A modeller should therefore verify district topology and temporal fit before comparing policy scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this raster release. The GeoTIFF was not downloaded, so its cell projection, code values and blank mask were not independently checked.
name: Vienna administration districts [100m]
